_comment: Settings to merge into a CMS 12 site's appsettings.json. Not a drop-in file.
Optimizely.Performance.Counters.CMS reads no configuration of its own - the initialization
module is discovered automatically and instruments unconditionally. Everything below is
Application Insights and logging, which is what decides whether you can see the counters.

_comment_EnableAdaptiveSampling: Leave sampling off while verifying. Adaptive sampling drops telemetry under load, and a
counter that is simply being sampled away looks exactly like one that is not being

_comment_Modules: Information on these two is what tells you the modules ran: the detected versus expected
Optimizely version, which telemetry systems were found, and each decorator as it is
registered. Drop them to Warning once the site is verified.
